title.tr: Teras üstü OSB kaplı zemin ve dayalı merdiven
title.en: OSB-covered terrace floor with a leaning ladder

alt.tr: OSB levhalarla kaplanmış teras zemini, yanında ahşap korkuluklu beyaz bina ve duvara dayalı merdiven
alt.en: Terrace floor covered with OSB boards, beside a white building with a timber balustrade and a ladder against the wall

caption.tr: Zemin henüz yalnızca OSB ile örtülü, son kat uygulanmamış. Binanın ahşap doğramaları koyu verniklidir.
caption.en: The floor is covered only with OSB so far and no top layer has been applied. The timber joinery of the building is finished in a dark varnish.
